variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 18:19 reads 'the goings out of the border were at the north bay'. As at 18:14, the plural 'were' is fixed by the English subject 'goings out' and does not report the Hebrew verb's number, so plural qere whyw and singular ketiv whyh are equally rendered. The mapped note is a hebrew_gloss on 'bay' (Hebrew tongue) and says nothing of the verb. Base fallback (qere) retained.

ASV 18:19 renders this lemma 'the goings out of the border', a construct genitive with the following noun and no possessive pronoun. That is the qere twc'wt (construct). The ketiv twc'wtyw carries a 3ms suffix, which the ASV renders 'the goings out thereof' wherever it stands, as at 18:12 and 18:14 in this same chapter's ASV shown here. The presence of 'of the border' in place of 'thereof' distinguishes the unsuffixed construct reading.
